mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE indicate a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving average indicate robust consumer demand and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months during late-cycle expansions when HOUST exceeds its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding economic output and corporate capacity utilization, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, economic weakness suppresses corporate earnings growth and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in HOUST and RSAFS reflect strong consumer demand and business activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with concurrent HOUST and RSAFS growth, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeding 3.0%), monetary tightening pressures depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months during high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.
